items.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My name is Monk Rowe and I am in the Brubeck residence... Iola was interviewed... by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Iola was interviewed in Wilton, Connecticut on July 17, 2011, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am in the Brubeck residence in Wilton, Connecticut, and I’m very, very pleased to have Iola Brubeck with me today for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College.
